stars.why: Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett are both out again, so Toronto's offense runs through Barnes against Milwaukee; he played 37 minutes Friday in his second game back from a groin strain. Collin Murray-Boyles is probable to return from the concussion protocol, which helps the frontcourt but does not cut into Barnes' role.

Gilgeous-Alexander missed Sunday at Miami with a neck strain and a lower back contusion, his first absence of the season, and Oklahoma City had not filed today's injury report this morning, so his status at Indiana is not posted. If he plays on this thin roster, he is the offense; the Thunder dressed only nine players Sunday.

Avdija came back from a foot contusion Saturday and played 36 minutes, and Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci are all still out for Portland. He is not on today's injury report, so he stays the Blazers' main creator at Philadelphia. His game has a 231.5-point total.

Jerome returned Saturday from three games out with hip soreness and started for 27 minutes. Memphis is without Cameron Boozer, Jerami Grant, GG Jackson and Scotty Pippen Jr. at Charlotte, so there is room for his minutes to climb back toward 30.

Phoenix has spread its minutes across the bench lately, but Booker is the exception at 37 and 38 minutes in two of his last three games. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery and New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray and Bennedict Mathurin, while Zion Williamson is probable. His game has a 232.5-point total.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: he played 27.0 minutes a game in the 1 game without them this season.
scrubs.why: Hendricks played 27 minutes off the bench Saturday with Cameron Boozer out, his most since 29 on November 14, and Boozer and Jerami Grant are both out again tonight. His minutes have swung from 11 to 29 this month, so he is a frontcourt fill-in rather than a locked-in starter.

scrubs.note: Moved toward his recent minutes (27.3 a game).
scrubs.why: Hield started Sunday with Norman Powell (hamstring) and Caleb Wilson (fractured hand) out, played 40 minutes in overtime and was on the floor at the finish. Chicago is on the second night of a back-to-back against Cleveland and had not filed today's report this morning, so Powell's status is not posted. His game has a 241.5-point total.

Wolf moved into the starting lineup Friday when Egor Demin went to the bench and played 26 minutes. Nolan Traore hurt his hamstring in that game and is out tonight, which keeps a starting spot open, but Brooklyn has not said who starts at Minnesota.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Grayson Allen and Dennis Schroder out: he played 32.0 minutes a game in the 1 game without them this season.
scrubs.why: Kon Knueppel, Dennis Schroder and Grayson Allen (concussion protocol) are all out for Charlotte, and James started Friday and played 32 minutes. Brandon Miller is probable, so James stays in a starter's role as a defender and spot-up shooter.

Wells has started each of Memphis' recent games at 24 to 27 minutes, and the Grizzlies are without Cameron Boozer, Jerami Grant, GG Jackson and Scotty Pippen Jr. at Charlotte. Ty Jerome's return Saturday pushed Cam Spencer to the bench, not Wells.

scrubs.note: More minutes with RJ Barrett and Kawhi Leonard out: he played 32.0 minutes a game in the 2 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Graves started Friday with Collin Murray-Boyles in the concussion protocol and played 33 minutes, but Murray-Boyles is probable tonight. Before that injury Graves played 13 to 16 minutes off the bench, so his role likely shrinks with Murray-Boyles back.

Ighodaro has started every Phoenix game in our box scores since November 10, playing 17 to 33 minutes, and Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery. His value comes from defense and rebounds rather than scoring. His game has a 232.5-point total.

scrubs.note: Moved toward his recent minutes (17.7 a game).
scrubs.why: He has averaged 19 minutes over his 15 games, with 12 last time out. He is a key bench piece in our rotation at about 19 minutes. His game has the highest total on the slate (241.5).

guide: Pair two or three stars with two or three scrubs, then fill the middle. The scrubs are what make the stars fit under the $50,000 cap.
